nodes.claim: Six analytic binders: alpha>0; alpha<=beta; V C2; all x,v lower and upper Hessian bounds bundled; eta>0; beta*eta<=1.
nodes.boundary: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel typing and rank0 extension are separate. Do not strengthen assumptions; some are unused in this local deterministic argument.

nodes.claim: c=y-eta gradV(r), h_r(x)=gradV(x)-gradV(r), literal harmonic Phi, S(x,p)=(x,R_h p) with R0=I, lambda=sqrt(eta)*max(<p,h>,0), Lambda_z(u)=integral_0^u lambda(Phi_s z) ds.
nodes.boundary: No alternative bounce or rate semantics.

nodes.claim: For n in Nat, finite T>=0, t in Delta_n(T): 0<t1<...<tn<T; t0=0,t_(n+1)=T.
nodes.boundary: For n=0 the empty tuple exists even T=0; for n>0,T=0 there is no tuple.

nodes.claim: z0 arbitrary; a_j=Phi_(tj-t_(j-1)) z_(j-1); z_j=S(a_j), 1<=j<=n.
nodes.boundary: Prescribed events need not have positive rate or arise from actual clocks.

nodes.claim: Gamma(s)=Phi_(s-tj) z_j for tj<=s<t_(j+1); Gamma(T)=Phi_(T-tn) z_n; internal jump value z_j.
nodes.boundary: Path domain closed [0,T]; no ambient extension or raw actual-process fallback involved.

nodes.claim: C2 V gives continuous gradient; literal lambda is continuous and nonnegative; s maps to Phi_s z is continuous for each z.
nodes.boundary: Bounce may be discontinuous at zero normal; no bounce continuity required.

nodes.claim: On each open interval (tj,t_(j+1)), Gamma(s)=Phi_(s-tj) z_j. On (t_(j-1),tj), Gamma uses incoming arc j-1.
For every j=0,...,n, lambda(Phi_(s-tj) z_j) is continuous and integrable on [tj,t_(j+1)].
nodes.boundary: Continuity on finite compact intervals supplies integrability internally; uniform energy cap unnecessary.

nodes.claim: The finite set {t0,...,t_(n+1)} is Lebesgue null; arc and post-bounce path integrands agree away from it.
nodes.boundary: This deterministic integration null set is different from fixed-horizon event-time atomlessness END93. No endpoint state equality asserted.

nodes.claim: s maps to lambda(Gamma(s)) is Lebesgue integrable on [0,T].
nodes.boundary: Use finite interval partition and finite-null modifications; no generic joint evaluation on uncountable product path space.

nodes.claim: For j=0,...,n, integral_tj^t_(j+1) lambda(Phi_(s-tj) z_j) ds = Lambda_zj(t_(j+1)-tj).
nodes.boundary: Translation of a finite Lebesgue integral, including terminal j=n and zero length when n=0,T=0.

nodes.claim: integral_0^T lambda(Gamma(s)) ds = sum_(j=0)^n Lambda_zj(t_(j+1)-tj).
nodes.boundary: Refines HAZARD93; not stochastic survival or law identity.

nodes.claim: For each 1<=j<=n, lim_(s upward tj within [0,T]) Gamma(s)=a_j. Hence the source factor lambda(Gamma(tj-))=lambda(a_j).
nodes.boundary: Strict ordering makes tj an interior time with an incoming interval. Gamma(tj)=S(a_j), and lambda(Gamma(tj)) must not replace lambda(a_j).

nodes.claim: q_n(t)=product_(j=1)^n ofReal(exp(-Lambda_z_(j-1)(tj-t_(j-1)))*lambda(a_j)); rho_n,T=q_n*ofReal(exp(-Lambda_zn(T-tn))).
nodes.boundary: Mathematical finite-clock factorization already used by path93; not a new stochastic premise. Compatibility with exact sealed literal definition must be checked later, not chosen from implementation here.

nodes.claim: Nonnegative incoming rates and positive exponential permit finite ofReal product multiplication; exp of negative finite sum is the product of all completed and final survival factors.
nodes.boundary: Zero rates allowed; no division, no conditional normalization, no infinity cancellation.

nodes.claim: For every ordered finite tuple, PATHINT94 and STITCH94 and all LEFT94 clauses hold, and rho_n,T(t)=ofReal(exp(-integral_0^T lambda(Gamma(s)) ds)*product_(j=1)^n lambda(Gamma(tj-))).
nodes.boundary: One bounded deterministic prescribed_finite_path_density_rewrite; no new SAU, implementation or completion credit.

nodes.claim: n0: one terminal arc and empty jump product1; T0,n0: integral0,rho1; T0,n>0: empty domain; rank0 or zero incoming rate permits zero density.
nodes.boundary: n0,T>0 density is exp(-Lambda_z0(T)), not normalized1.

nodes.claim: Finite-count complete-history/path law with density rho and arbitrary nonnegative coordinate-measurable tests.
nodes.boundary: Root reports independent VERIFIED science93; that state is not re-certified or modified here. No production reread.

nodes.claim: Substitute DENSITY94 into JOINT93 to obtain the literal A7 fixed-count whole-path density term.
nodes.boundary: This remains an actual needed substitution, not a wrapper claiming whole A7.

nodes.claim: At fixed parameters and T, measurable finite count sectors are pairwise disjoint and cover almost surely.
nodes.boundary: Keep forall fixed T outside AE quantification; no new nonexplosion proof.

nodes.claim: Source energy preservation gives uniform rate cap along all prescribed paths with fixed initial energy.
nodes.boundary: For future printed CAP93; no new energy theorem credit and not needed for DENSITY94.

nodes.claim: For bounded real Psi, abs(sector_n)<=M*(LT)^n/n!, using source rate cap on prescribed paths, survival<=1 and simplex volume T^n/n!.
nodes.boundary: Must derive cap from geometry, not add it as source binder.

nodes.claim: Use sector mass=P(N_T=n), sum masses1, abs(sector_n)<=M*P(N_T=n); nonnegative Tonelli and positive/negative parts justify signed assembly.
nodes.boundary: ASTIS alternative; not printed author proof, no simplex-volume theorem credit.

nodes.claim: Countable finite-sector sum equals expectation for every bounded measurable real path functional; each signed integral exists and sum converges absolutely.
nodes.boundary: TERM93 and COUNT93 and one fully justified CAP93/MASS93 route. No full A7 or paper completion here.

nodes.claim: Coordinate-product sigma suffices for selected measurable-functional law. Source does not specify topology; explicit arcs suffice for this deterministic time integral.
nodes.boundary: Do not assume generic jointly measurable evaluation on all functions; Borel-Skorokhod compatibility remains SKOR93, out of scope.

source_assumptions_vs_dependencies.analytic_binders: h_alpha,h_alpha_beta,hV,hH(two inequalities bundled),h_eta,h_beta_eta; finite-space typing is separate
source_assumptions_vs_dependencies.quantifiers: After the six source analytic hypotheses: for every deterministic y,r,z0, every n in Nat, every finite T>=0, and every t in strict Delta_n(T). All identities are pointwise deterministic on this simplex. For each jump j=1,...,n prove the left-limit clause. No almost-everywhere qualifier on prescribed tuples and no positivity assumption on every event rate.
source_assumptions_vs_dependencies.typing: Real finite-dimensional Hilbert/Borel phase space, with disclosed rank0 extension of Euclidean source.
dependencies_not_binders: integrability of each arc or whole prescribed rate
positive jump rates or positive count mass

target_AND_route: Finite arc continuity, finite-null endpoint bridge, integral translation and finite addition, incoming left limits, nonnegative exponential/product algebra. No optional global-cap premise.

edge_cases.n0_Tpositive: Empty jump product=1; one arc; rho0=exp(-Lambda_z0(T)), generally less than1.
edge_cases.n0_T0: Singleton empty tuple, constant initial phase at the sole coordinate, zero integral and density1.
edge_cases.npositive_T0: Strict simplex empty; all tuple statements vacuous, corresponding measure term zero.
edge_cases.rank0: Unique phase, rate and hazard zero; density0 on any n>0 tuple because all jump-rate factors vanish. No assumption of positive density.
edge_cases.zero_rate_or_infinite_actual_wait: Prescribed finite path is still defined even if impossible under actual clocks; zero rate factors give zero density. No finite waiting-time premise is needed.

path_conventions: Gamma is defined on closed [0,T], post-bounce at internal event instants.
The last arc includes T for path evaluation; endpoint inclusion does not alter a Lebesgue integral.

State the left limit within [0,T]; do not introduce an unspecified extension outside that interval. Any chosen total extension needs explicit agreement and extension-independence at interior jump times.
No left limit is demanded at initial time0 or at nonexistent jumps.
Zero-normal reflection remains identity; bounce continuity is unnecessary and must not be assumed.

path_sigma_assessment.primary_wording: The A7 excerpt says bounded measurable functional and does not specify a path topology or sigma algebra.
path_sigma_assessment.reason: Coordinate-measurable actual/prescribed path maps support composition with every functional measurable for that specified sigma algebra; count partition and signed-integral arguments require no Skorokhod structure.
path_sigma_assessment.finite_density_warning: Generic jointly measurable evaluation (path,s)->path(s) on an uncountable product does not follow. Prove time integrability along the explicit finite prescribed path using its arcs; after the density equality, simplex measurability can be transferred from already measurable rho or proved from the finite formula.
path_sigma_assessment.stronger_claim_not_licensed: No assertion that this covers every Borel functional for an unspecified Skorokhod/continuous path topology. Source intent on that extra topology is not resolved by these paragraphs. If the public target selects a Skorokhod carrier, path regularity and coordinate/Borel compatibility must be proved as SKOR93.
path_sigma_assessment.repair: No source repair proposed; retain explicit coordinate-sigma completion and separate compatibility boundary.
